text: With the fall of this house, a child of its blood has been left with no one. They have been brought into your court for now, though your ministers are already divided on what should become of them. Raise them among your own, and one day they may serve you as kin. Send them on to distant relations, and you spare yourself a rival's blood beneath your roof.
The child is kept in your court.
The child is sent on to another house of their people.
